title: Restart Re-Pricing Value — Professional Services Projects Calculation
content:
In Professional Services Projects, the restart re-pricing of a held engagement is figured on its remaining value.

## Definitions

- **Remaining value.** The remaining value is the engagement's contract value, which every signed change order has moved by its value change, less everything already billed by the deposit and milestone invoices.
- **Restart re-pricing.** The restart re-pricing is 4.0 percent of the remaining value, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Percentage points.** Any percentage points of the restart re-pricing are figured on the remaining value: points added and points taken off are netted, points taken off counting as negative, and that net percentage of the remaining value is added to the restart re-pricing.
- **Rounding.** The restart re-pricing is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- Contract value 120000.00, of which the deposit and milestone invoices have billed 70000.00: the remaining value is 50000.00 and the restart re-pricing is 4.0 percent of it, that is 2000.00.
- On the same remaining value, 1.5 points added and 1.0 point taken off net to 0.5 point, which is 250.00, so the restart re-pricing is 2250.00.
- Remaining value 33333.33: 4.0 percent is 1333.3332, rounded half up to the cent at the end, 1333.33.
